name: markdown-preview-colours
description: Colour presets for the built-in Markdown preview: headings, bold text, inline code, quotes and links. Preview only; Markdown files are never changed.

enumDescriptions: Dark. Green-teal headings, amber bold, orange inline code.
Light. Green and teal headings, dark amber bold, orange inline code.
Dark. Plum and lavender headings on charcoal, with blue, yellow, red and green accents.
Light. Deep plum headings with blue, amber, red and green accents.
Dark. Red headings on near-black, white bold, cyan links.
Light. Red headings, black bold, slate inline code, teal links.
Dark. Gold, amber and orange headings on near-black, white bold, teal links.
Light. Dark gold, amber and rust headings on cream, black bold, teal links.
Dark. Greyscale headings and text; links are the only colour.
Light. Near-black and grey headings and text; links are the only colour.
Dark. Terminal greens on green-black, lime inline code, cyan links.
Light. Dark greens on pale green, olive inline code, teal links.
Dark. Gold and tan headings on warm charcoal, cream bold, orange inline code, light blue links.
Light. Gold and brown headings on beige paper, dark brown bold, rust inline code, ink-blue links.
Dark. Light blue headings, white bold, light blue inline code.
Light. Blue headings, near-black bold, blue inline code.
Dark. Claude Code docs look: white headings, grey text on near-black, orange-underlined links, green, blue and yellow callouts.
Light. Claude Code docs look: near-black headings, dark grey text on off-white, black-underlined links, green, blue and yellow callouts.
Dark. Document style: near-white headings, warm grey text on charcoal, soft red inline code, light blue links.
Light. Document style: near-black headings, warm grey text on off-white, dark red inline code, blue links.
Dark. White headings on near-black, amber bold, orange inline code, soft blue links, blue, green and amber callouts.
Light. Black headings on white, dark amber bold, orange inline code, blue links, blue, green and amber callouts.
Dark. Docs style: white headings, light grey text on near-black, orange inline code without a box, dotted link underlines, grey callouts.
Light. Docs style: black headings and text on white, orange inline code without a box, dotted link underlines, grey callouts.
Dark. Docs style: light grey text and headings on charcoal, grey inline code in a bordered box, soft grey link underlines, blue, green and amber callouts.
Light. Docs style: near-black text and headings on white, inline code in a bordered box, soft grey link underlines, blue, green and amber callouts.
Dark. Docs style: off-white text on blue-black, grey inline code, solid link underlines, rounded striped tables, callouts with a coloured left bar.
Light. Docs style: near-black text on white, light grey inline code, solid link underlines, rounded striped tables, callouts with a coloured left bar.
Built-in VS Code preview look (turns all colouring off).
markdownPreviewPalettes.preset.markdownDescription: Colour preset for the Markdown preview. Every palette has a `-dark` and a `-light` preset, shown as chosen in any VS Code theme. `default` restores the built-in VS Code look. High-contrast themes always keep the built-in look.
